response.sql: WITH fielding_by_hand AS (SELECT p.bats, COUNT(*) as count FROM fielding f JOIN player p ON f.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY p.bats), stats AS (SELECT SUM(count) as total_count, COUNT(*) as num_hands, SUM(count) / COUNT(*) as avg_count FROM fielding_by_hand) SELECT fbh.bats, fbh.count, fbh.count / s.total_count as share, fbh.count - s.avg_count as above_average FROM fielding_by_hand fbh CROSS JOIN stats s WHERE fbh.count > s.avg_count
